name: Background pattern
description: A Monsoon Rain image repeats down the start or end edge of a section. Patterned text may use a translucent backdrop in the section's color.
sources: az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2111: Monsoon Sky image, tile size and opacity; section-color text legibility backdrop
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2308: proportional edge band and its minimum and maximum

root.description: A section with a pattern on either edge.

band.description: The Monsoon Rain tile repeats vertically at the chosen edge. The band's proportional width is clamped between its minimum and maximum.

text-backdrop.description: Paragraphs, list items and rules use the section's color, or White when none is set, behind the text.
